clients.description: List of RADIUS clients to accept requests from. Each entry is a client definition line (e.g., 10.0.0.0/8 secret123)

udp_servers.description: List of backend RADIUS UDP servers to forward requests to (non-TLS). Each entry is a server definition line.

tcp_servers.description: List of backend RADIUS/TLS (RadSec) servers to forward requests to. Each entry is a server definition line.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to console/syslog

log_file.description: Path to log file (if empty, logs to syslog)

stats_port.description: UDP port for statistics queries (e.g., for monitoring tools)

listen_addr.description: Local IP address to bind listening sockets (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::')

use_tls.description: Enable TLS support for RadSec (required for TCP/TLS servers)

ca_cert_file.description: CA certificate file for verifying server/client certificates

server_cert_file.description: Server certificate file (for incoming RadSec connections); leave empty to disable server mode

server_key_file.description: Server private key file (must match server_cert_file)

client_cert_file.description: Client certificate file (for outgoing RadSec connections to upstream servers)

client_key_file.description: Client private key file (must match client_cert_file)

tls_cipher_list.description: OpenSSL-compatible cipher list for TLS connections

tls_verify_cert.description: Require and verify certificates in TLS connections (RadSec)

default_realm.description: Realm to append to usernames that lack one (e.g., 'example.com')

fallback_realm.description: Realm to use when no realm matches and no client-specific realm

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for RADIUS requests

retries.description: Max retries before giving up on a RADIUS request

realms.description: Realm-to-server mapping definitions. Each entry is a realm line.
